description: Paired 100-point A/B evaluation rubrics for all 24 Cortex v0.4.0 skills (Without-Skill vs. With-Skill).

tasks.prompt: I have grades.csv (40 students, two duplicate IDs, one blank midterm) and syllabus.json (weights: labs 0.30, midterm 0.30, final 0.45). Compute everyone's final grade, summarize the class, and save progress so I can resume tomorrow.

rubric.description: Catches that rubric weights sum to 1.05 instead of 1.00 before computing grades
Uses Python Decimal (not LLM mental math or float) with explicit rounding
Quarantines duplicate IDs and reports blank midterm explicitly instead of silently guessing
Persists structured context.json state for session resumption
Reports evidence/verification counts and clear next steps

tasks.prompt: Audit this snippet and claim: `import requests; r = requests.get('https://example.com', retries=3); print(r.text_lines())` — the author claims this improves reliability by 40% and fixes CVE-2026-99999.

rubric.description: Flags `retries=3` as a non-existent kwarg on `requests.get`
Flags `r.text_lines()` as a fabricated method on `requests.Response`
Flags CVE-2026-99999 and the 40% claim as UNVERIFIED rather than accepting them
Provides or executes deterministic Python AST/inspect/hasattr checks
Outputs an explicit Audit Verdict and claim-by-claim verification matrix

tasks.prompt: I scaled a cube non-uniformly into a low-poly wooden chair in Blender 4.2 for Unity and 3D printing. Give me the modeling/export checklist and a validation script.

rubric.description: Requires applying Rotation & Scale (Ctrl+A) to (1,1,1) before beveling/UV unwrapping
Accounts for Blender 4.x API differences (Smooth by Angle / Principled BSDF)
Provides a headless bpy/bmesh script checking non-manifold, boundary edges, and loose verts
Enforces 0 non-manifold and 0 boundary edges for watertight 3D-print export
Includes Face Orientation/normal recalculation and UV packing margin checks
Flags OS command injection and path traversal in os.system as P0 Blocker
Flags shared mutable default argument `cache=[]`
Flags bare `except: pass` swallowing errors
Emits explicit Review Verdict (REQUEST_CHANGES) and severity labels
Includes concrete missing regression test cases and minimal secure fix

tasks.prompt: Write a Python grading pipeline that computes weighted scores from grades.csv, assigns letter grades (A- >= 90, B+ >= 87), escapes HTML student names, and reconciles output report cards.

rubric.description: Uses Decimal with ROUND_HALF_UP to avoid floating-point boundary bugs
Validates rubric weight sum == 1.00 and descending non-overlapping cutoffs
Escapes student names and comments with html.escape before HTML rendering
Binds comments strictly to computed category scores without inventing traits
Reconciles generated card count and writes an audit_summary.json

tasks.prompt: Document a Python FastAPI service with two routes (`GET /health`, `POST /items`), an env var `API_KEY` (no default), and a Mermaid diagram.

rubric.description: Documents API_KEY in an env table explicitly marked Required (no default)
Includes concrete 2xx success AND error response payload examples
Provides a concise Mermaid diagram using a fenced mermaid block
Includes code-truth / relative-link / command verification steps
Avoids inventing unverified scripts or non-existent directories

tasks.prompt: Design a cross-session context.json update flow when we change our database choice from SQLite to PostgreSQL while preserving prior decision history safely.

rubric.description: Uses versioned JSON schema with schema_version, updated_at, constraints, decisions, tasks
Marks the old SQLite decision superseded and appends a new decision instead of deleting
Checks referenced file paths/hashes and tags changed facts as STALE
Writes via temporary file + json.loads sanity check + os.replace
Explicitly forbids storing secrets/API keys/passwords in context.json

tasks.prompt: Write a Python script that loads a YAML config file, runs a user-selected subcommand with a timeout, and totals currency values from a CSV file.

rubric.description: Uses `from __future__ import annotations` and full parameter/return type annotations
Uses `yaml.safe_load` instead of unsafe `yaml.load`
Uses `subprocess.run` with list args (no shell=True), check=True, and explicit timeout
Uses `Decimal` for currency math and `pathlib.Path` with explicit UTF-8 encoding
Includes verification commands (`py_compile`, `ruff`/`mypy`, and edge-case tests)

tasks.prompt: Set up a pytest suite and pyproject.toml configuration for a Python CSV parser module that reads files and checks an environment variable `MAX_ROWS`.

rubric.description: Configures branch=true, show_missing=true, and fail_under in pyproject.toml
Uses strict pytest options (`--strict-markers`, `--strict-config`)
Uses `@pytest.mark.parametrize` and `pytest.raises(..., match=...)` for boundaries
Uses `tmp_path` and `monkeypatch` for zero-flakiness file and env isolation
Provides exact branch coverage verification command (`--cov-branch --cov-report=term-missing`)

tasks.prompt: Build a Python scraper for paginated product catalog pages at `https://shop.example.com/catalog` that extracts title, price, and stock status to JSONL.

rubric.description: Checks robots.txt via RobotFileParser with an explicit User-Agent before fetching
Enforces explicit request timeout, per-domain rate limit/jitter, and bounded backoff honoring Retry-After
Prevents infinite pagination via visited URL set and max_pages cap
Stores None for missing fields, uses Decimal for price, and quarantines invalid rows
Includes provenance fields (source_url, fetched_at) and an offline HTML fixture test

tasks.prompt: Design an OpenAPI 3.1 REST API for creating and listing payment orders (`/v1/orders`) with safe retries and error handling.

rubric.description: Uses cursor-based pagination with capped limit instead of unbounded lists
Uses RFC 9457 `application/problem+json` ProblemDetails error schema
Requires `Idempotency-Key` header on POST /v1/orders and returns 201 + Location
Uses `additionalProperties: false`, explicit formats/bounds, and rate-limit headers
Provides OpenAPI validation command and executable contract test cases

tasks.prompt: Plan and execute migrating a legacy Python 2.7 CSV billing module (using `/`, `dict.keys()`, `str`/`unicode`, and `round()`) to Python 3.12.

rubric.description: Captures golden-master / characterization tests BEFORE modifying source code
Explicitly audits `/` vs `//` division, `bytes` vs `str`, iterator views, and banker's rounding
Separates mechanical syntax vs semantic fixes and forbids speculative feature additions
Runs side-by-side parity tests plus static checks (`mypy`/`ruff`)
Includes an explicit rollback and cutover checklist

tasks.prompt: Optimize this PostgreSQL query on a 50M-row `orders` table: `SELECT * FROM orders WHERE LOWER(customer_email) = 'a@b.com' AND status = 'pending' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 20 OFFSET 10000;`

rubric.description: Requests or provides `EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS)` and flags missing-plan assumptions
Fixes non-sargable `LOWER(customer_email)` via expression index or `citext`
Applies ESR composite/partial index ordering using `CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY`
Replaces deep `OFFSET 10000` with keyset pagination and replaces `SELECT *`
Documents index write-amplification / storage / redundancy trade-offs

tasks.prompt: Create a GitHub Actions workflow triggered on pull requests that echoes the PR title, runs npm tests, and uploads SARIF security findings.

rubric.description: Sets minimal top-level `permissions:` and scopes `security-events: write` only to the scan job
Passes PR title via `env:` variable instead of interpolating `${{ github.event.pull_request.title }}` directly in `run:`
Configures `concurrency:` cancel-in-progress (protecting main) and `timeout-minutes:`
Uses `npm ci` + lockfile caching and addresses SHA pinning without inventing fake SHAs
Includes YAML parse / `actionlint` verification

tasks.prompt: Containerize a TypeScript Node 22 Express API (`npm run build` -> `dist/server.js`, port 3000) with PostgreSQL in Compose.

rubric.description: Uses a multi-stage Dockerfile with pinned minor Node 22 tag (never `:latest`)
Copies `package*.json` and runs `npm ci` before copying source code
Switches to non-root `USER` and uses JSON `exec`-form `CMD ["node", ...]` for SIGTERM
Provides a `.dockerignore` excluding `.git`, `node_modules`, and `.env*`
Hardens `compose.yaml` with `healthcheck`, `service_healthy`, `cap_drop: [ALL]`, and `no-new-privileges`

tasks.prompt: This Python function slows down on 50,000 items because it checks `if item in seen_list:` and builds output with `out += line`. Profile and optimize it.

rubric.description: Creates a reproducible benchmark with warmup runs, median/p95 latency, and tracemalloc/RSS
Uses real `cProfile` profiling instead of guessing numbers
Replaces O(N^2) list membership with `set` and string `+=` with `''.join()`
Formats a structured Before vs. After metrics table without fabricated numbers
Verifies exact functional output equality (`baseline == optimized`) after optimization

tasks.prompt: Refactor a 120-line deeply nested (depth 6) `process_order` function that mixes validation, 2 discount types, and file logging without breaking callers.

rubric.description: Requires running/writing characterization tests BEFORE refactoring
Flattens nesting using early-return guard clauses
Separates pure validation/pricing logic from file logging side effects
Avoids heavy Strategy/Factory class hierarchies for only 2 discount variants
Reports before/after complexity metrics (nesting depth, length) and test verification
Maps findings accurately to CWE-89 (SQLi), CWE-22 (Path Traversal), and CWE-798 (Hardcoded Secret)
Redacts the hardcoded token instead of echoing the full secret value verbatim
Provides explicit Source -> Sink trace and concrete exploit payloads for each finding
Provides parameterized SQL and `Path.resolve().is_relative_to()` remediation patches
Uses Critical/High severity classification and invents zero fake CVEs

tasks.prompt: Generate a reusable AWS Terraform module for a private S3 data bucket with KMS encryption and least-privilege read-only IAM policy.

rubric.description: Separates `versions.tf`, `variables.tf`, `main.tf`, `outputs.tf` with pinned provider constraints
Uses v5 separate resources (`aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block`, `aws_s3_bucket_server_side_encryption_configuration`, versioning)
Uses `data "aws_iam_policy_document"` with scoped actions/ARNs (no `*` wildcards)
Includes variable `validation {}` blocks and `lifecycle { prevent_destroy = true }`
Includes `terraform fmt -check` / `terraform validate` commands and KMS/storage cost notes

tasks.prompt: Generate unit tests for `def apply_discount(price: Decimal, pct: int, now: datetime) -> Decimal` which rejects negative prices, rejects pct outside 0..100, and adds 5% extra off on Fridays.

rubric.description: Maps every branch/guard clause to specific test functions in a coverage checklist
Tests exact boundaries (`price=0`, `pct=0`, `pct=100`, `pct=-1`, `pct=101`, negative price)
Passes fixed `datetime` values for Friday vs non-Friday instead of calling `datetime.now()`
Asserts exact exception types and message matches (`pytest.raises(..., match=...)`)
Provides runnable `pytest --cov --cov-branch` execution verification

tasks.prompt: Checkout API 5xx jumped from 0.1% to 38% 12 minutes after deploy v2.14.0. Pods are OOMKilling and the team wants to drop the dead-letter queue and restart Postgres. Give me the incident plan and postmortem template.

rubric.description: Classifies SEV-1/SEV-2 and blocks destructive queue purge / Postgres restart before evidence snapshot and confirmation
Prioritizes immediate reversible rollback of v2.14.0 over deep root-cause debugging
Specifies UTC timeline and objective recovery verification signal
Includes blameless postmortem with contributing factors, owner, priority, and verification criterion

tasks.prompt: We merged 4 new features, 2 bug fixes, and bumped package.json to 0.3.0 while plugin.json is still 0.2.0. Prepare the release plan, changelog, and rollback steps.

rubric.description: Computes SemVer minor bump deterministically from commit history
Catches and blocks release on package.json (0.3.0) vs plugin.json (0.2.0) version mismatch
Requires real pre-release verification gates and SHA-256 checksums
Provides rollback/hotfix procedure without mutating immutable published tags

tasks.prompt: Instrument our Python FastAPI payment service with logs, Prometheus metrics (someone suggested labeling by user_id and request_id), tracing, and PagerDuty alerts on CPU > 70%.

rubric.description: Explicitly rejects user_id and request_id as metric labels to prevent cardinality explosion
Specifies structured JSON logs with trace_id correlation and PII/secret redaction
Defines RED/USE metrics and measurable SLI/SLO with error budget
Replaces noisy CPU > 70% page with symptom-based SLO burn-rate alert and runbook

tasks.prompt:
Audit a modal form with `
Save
`, ``, `outline: none` in CSS, and `tabindex='5'`. Provide WCAG 2.2 AA fixes.

rubric.description: Replaces clickable <div> with native <button type='button'> for keyboard access (WCAG 2.1.1)
Flags placeholder-only input and adds explicit <label for> or aria-label
Removes positive tabindex=5 and restores visible :focus-visible styling
Covers WCAG 2.2 target size / forced-colors / reduced-motion and manual screen-reader verification
